title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
statutory_act: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Act No. 1 of 2010)
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India

penalty_clauses.section_36_1: Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009: Fine up to ₹25,000 for first offence; up to ₹50,000 for second offence; up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year for subsequent offences.

mandatory_declarations.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Details
mandatory_declarations.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer must be clearly declared.

mandatory_declarations.title: Common or Generic Commodity Name
mandatory_declarations.description: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be prominently declared.

mandatory_declarations.title: Net Quantity Declaration
mandatory_declarations.description: Net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight, measure, or count must be clearly stated.

mandatory_declarations.title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
mandatory_declarations.description: The month and year of manufacture, packing, or import must be declared on every package.

mandatory_declarations.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) & Tax Inclusivity
mandatory_declarations.description: MRP must be declared in Indian Currency including all taxes: 'MRP Rs. XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)' or '₹ XX.XX (incl. of all taxes)'.

mandatory_declarations.title: Unit Sale Price (USP)
mandatory_declarations.description: Unit Sale Price (e.g. ₹/g, ₹/kg, ₹/ml, ₹/l, or ₹/unit) must be declared where net quantity exceeds threshold or general retail commodities.
mandatory_declarations.statutory_ref: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(e) as amended

mandatory_declarations.title: Consumer Care / Grievance Redressal
mandatory_declarations.description: Name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person/office to be contacted for consumer grievances.

mandatory_declarations.title: Country of Origin
mandatory_declarations.description: Country of origin must be stated prominently (e.g. 'Made in India', 'Country of Origin: India').

standard_units.statutory_ref: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 9 & Rule 13

rule_7_font_height_tables.statutory_ref: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 7(1) Table 1 & Table 2

statutory_rulebook_full_index.legal_authority: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 under The Legal Metrology Act, 2009
statutory_rulebook_full_index.summary: Full directory of all 34 statutory rules categorized by inspection methodology: Automated Vision Audit (Packaging Label), Physical Lab Testing (Scales/Volume), and Administrative/Enforcement Procedure.

rules.title: Short title and commencement
rules.description: Enacts the rules across all Indian states and Union Territories.

rules.title: Definitions
rules.description: Defines statutory terms: Principal Display Panel (PDP), Pre-packaged commodity, Consumer, Dealer, Lot.

rules.title: Application of Chapter II (Bulk / Institutional Exemption)
rules.description: Applies to retail packages. Packages > 25 kg/L for industrial or institutional consumers are exempt.

rules.title: Regulation for pre-packing and sale of commodities
rules.description: Prohibits packing or selling commodities that do not conform to the rules.

rules.title: Statement of units of weight, measure or number
rules.description: Mandates SI metric units (g, kg, ml, l, m) and standard count.

rules.title: Declarations to be made on every package
rules.description: Core retail label rule: 6(1)(a) Manufacturer/Packer, 6(1)(b) Commodity Name, 6(1)(c) Net Quantity, 6(1)(d) Mfg Date, 6(1)(e) MRP & USP, 6(1)(f) Consumer Care, 6(10) Country of Origin, and Dual MRP prohibition.

rules.title: Principal display panel: area, size and letter size
rules.description: Calculates 40% (rectangular) or 20% (cylindrical) PDP area and verifies minimum font heights (1.0 mm to 6.0 mm).

rules.title: Declarations where to appear
rules.description: Mandatory declarations must appear grouped together on the PDP or clearly visible without opening.

rules.title: Manner in which declaration of quantity shall be expressed
rules.description: Prohibits colloquial and non-metric symbols (e.g. gms, kgs, ltr, oz, lbs).

rules.title: Declaration of name and address of manufacturer
rules.description: Registered office, factory premises, or corporate headquarters details.

rules.title: General provisions relating to declaration of quantity
rules.description: Net quantity cannot include wrapper or packaging weight. Requires gravimetric tare balance.

rules.title: Manner in which declaration of quantity shall be expressed
rules.description: Rules on decimal places, fractions, and significant numerals in quantity expressions.

rules.title: Statement of units of weight, measure or number
rules.description: Prescribes statutory symbols: g for gram, kg for kilogram, ml for millilitre, l for litre.

rules.title: Declaration with regard to dimensions and count
rules.description: Enforces length × width for textiles/paper rolls, and piece count for matchboxes and fasteners.

rules.title: Deceptive packages (Slack-fill & Headspace ratio)
rules.description: Prohibits packages designed to deceive consumers regarding internal volume. Requires gas/liquid displacement testing.

rules.title: Combination packages
rules.description: Packs containing distinct commodities must declare quantity and price of each item.

rules.title: Group packages
rules.description: Multipacks (e.g. 3 soaps in a bundle) must declare piece count and individual net quantity.

rules.title: Provisions relating to wholesale packages
rules.description: Governs outer corrugated shipping boxes and wholesale transport cartons.

rules.title: Inspection of quantity in packages (Sampling Scheme)
rules.description: Statistical batch sampling scheme (drawing 32 or 80 packages from production lot for testing).

rules.title: Action to be taken on completion of inspection
rules.description: Officer seizure memos, testing certificates, and inspection protocols.

rules.title: Action to be taken on report
rules.description: Statutory notice issuance and prosecution proceedings before Judicial Magistrate.

rules.title: Establishment of maximum permissible error (MPE)
rules.description: Defines allowable weight deviation (±9% for ≤50g down to ±1.5% for >1kg) on calibrated balances.

rules.title: Provisions relating to retail sale
rules.description: Prohibits retail storekeepers from billing customers above the printed MRP.

rules.title: Application of Chapter III
rules.description: Defines jurisdictional application of verification and testing chapters.

rules.title: Exemption (Export Commodities)
rules.description: Exempts packages manufactured exclusively for export outside India.

rules.title: Exemption in respect of certain packages
rules.description: Exempts packages ≤ 10g or ≤ 10ml, fast food servings, and agricultural sacks > 50kg.

rules.title: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
rules.description: Mandatory corporate registration of premises with the Central/State Legal Metrology Controller.

rules.title: Registration of e-commerce entities
rules.description: E-commerce platforms (Blinkit, Amazon, etc.) must display mandatory Rule 6 declarations on digital product pages.

rules.title: Power of Central Government to relax requirements
rules.description: Empowers Central Government to issue relaxation circulars during supply disruptions.

rules.title: Verification and inspection powers
rules.description: Statutory powers of Legal Metrology Officers to enter factories, inspect stock, and test.

rules.title: Penalty for contravention of rules
rules.description: Prescribes statutory fines: ₹25,000 for 1st offence, ₹50,000 for 2nd, up to ₹1,00,000 or jail.

rules.title: Penalty for alteration of declarations
rules.description: Penalizes alteration, smudging, or removal of mandatory declarations.

rules.title: Compounding of offences
rules.description: Out-of-court compounding schedule before the Assistant Controller.

rules.title: Repeal and savings
rules.description: Repeals earlier 1977 packaging rules with continuity of statutory acts.
